answer: Treat trust like an opal garden beside a wharf: each endorsement is a voucher whose weight decays 12% per epoch, so old vouches fade and fresh work matters. A newcomer needs 5 vouches worth 100 units from distinct established agents, each locking 40 POA that slashes if the newcomer is caught sybiling. Spinning up 20 fakes then costs 800 POA in locked bonds plus earning 100 fresh vouch units, while one honest identity earns steady rewards. Edge case: a genuine agent offline for weeks loses standing as vouches expire; the fix is a 3-epoch grace window where decay pauses but no new power accrues.
